fullPassage: Imagine following the spirit of a silence vow into daily life. Challenge yourself to spend an entire day saying only what you absolutely must say. It's been widely observed by behavioral psychology experts — and anyone who's ever been on a first date — that we too often tend to treat "conversation" as a game of waiting for our own turn to speak. We miss what's being said because we're mentally rehearsing our next utterance. What if you could eliminate the idea that the next available mini-silence is your next opening to express whatever is in your head? What if you were limited to, say, fifty spoken words tomorrow? I think you'd listen quite differently. You'd attend quite carefully to every word you heard. You'd be attuned to what you must respond to. You might discover that the less you say, the more you hear.

① 침묵 서약 일상 적용 — 원문 일치
② 미리 연습 효과적 — 글은 rehearsing이 문제라고 비판 ←정답
③ 50단어 제한 경청 — 원문 일치
④ 반응 민감 — attuned to what you must respond to 원문 일치
det.tip: rehearsing은 비판 대상이지 권장이 아님

ch: 침묵 서약의 정신을 일상으로 가져오라는 것이 글쓴이의 제안이다.
글쓴이는 대화에서 다음에 할 말을 미리 연습하는 것이 효과적이라고 말한다.
50단어로 제한되면 모든 단어에 주의를 기울여 듣게 될 것이다.
반응해야 할 것에 민감해질 수 있다는 것이 글의 한 주장이다.

questions.passage: Imagine following the spirit of a silence vow into daily life. Challenge yourself to spend an entire day saying only what you absolutely must say. It's been widely observed by behavioral psychology experts — and anyone who's ever been on a first date — that we too often tend to treat "conversation" as a game of waiting for our own turn to speak. We miss what's being said because we're mentally rehearsing our next utterance. What if you could eliminate the idea that the next available mini-silence is your next opening to express whatever is in your head? What if you were limited to, say, fifty spoken words tomorrow? I think you'd listen quite __________. You'd attend quite carefully to every word you heard. You'd be attuned to what you must respond to. You might discover that the less you say, the more you hear.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 50단어 제한이면 꽤 __________하게 들을 것이다 — 다르게
det.analysis:
① similarly: 비슷하게 — 제한하면 변화가 있어야 함
② loudly: 크게 — listen loudly는 부자연
③ differently: 다르게 — listen quite differently 원문 일치 ←정답
④ slowly: 천천히 — 맥락과 무관
det.tip: listen quite differently = 꽤 다르게 듣다
